title-group.article-title: A canned JATS sample for the R2 storage adapter test

abstract.p: This tiny fixture stands in for a PMC JATS full-text body that the retrieval layer would upload to R2 under jats/<uid>.xml. It exists only so the storage test has a real-shaped text body to checksum, sync, and read back — no network is ever touched.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Open-access full text lives durably in object storage; the manifest keeps only metadata. The sha256 recorded per binary makes re-sync idempotent.
